findings.rationale: Accepted: emptiness is decided on the NORMALIZED value (same lowercase + strip-leading/trailing-space-and-punctuation the blacklist uses): normalized-empty → shape failure; otherwise blacklist. Bash and Node both order it that way; §1.1 rewritten.
Accepted: §2 autopilot-engine bullet rewritten — finalPanelSeatReceipt reads the top-level outcome.raw_log that performReview sets; no nested raw path.

Rejected: the version bump is a depth-0 release action after the merge (sync-version.js + CHANGELOG + INDEX), outside the sealed contract — the same convention as v2.36.53/54/55/56 and stated in §2 Docs; the hand writes the pinned number into BACKLOG/l5 text exactly as those deliverables did and the scope-integrity criterion is evaluated on the merge commit, not on the release commit. §2 Docs gains one clarifying sentence.
